headline: Spies, Blues
& Scarecrows
dek: Culper Spy Day takes over Setauket, Blues on the Harbor finally gets its day in Port Jeff, and the scarecrows move into Stony Brook Village. Here's everything worth doing in Three Village this weekend, updated live.

hero.credit: Setauket Post Office. Photo: Vitsuha, CC0

limehof.name: LI Music & Entertainment Hall of Fame

events.title: Three Village Farmers & Artisans Market
events.desc: 40-plus farmers, bakers and makers on the historical society lawn. Fall hours now, so it wraps at 6.

events.title: Stitch & Chit-Chat
events.desc: Bring whatever you're knitting, crocheting or stitching and settle in with other makers at the museum.

events.title: Culper Spy Day
events.desc: The 12th annual celebration of Washington's spy ring, right where it happened. George Washington raises the flag at 10, then it's musket drills, invisible ink, a spy musical, an encampment, and a free hop-on trolley to 10 historic sites.

events.title: Cedar Beach Blues on the Harbor
events.desc: 36 years strong and pushed back a week by the nor'easter. Two stages of New York blues on the waterfront. Bring a chair. If it rains, it moves into the Port Jefferson Village Center.

events.title: Treason's Trial: A Culper Spy Story
events.desc: World premiere of a brand-new play with music about how Washington's spy ring was born, set in the powder keg of May 1776. Two shows only, 2:30 and 4:30.

events.title: Spy Day on the Library Lawn
events.desc: Revolutionary tunes live from 12 to 2, kids' games and a spy-themed craft until 4, free popcorn, and library history tours.

events.title: Free Day at the Long Island Museum
events.desc: Free admission for Spy Day. See the only known surviving letter between Tallmadge and Culper Jr., plus a Battle of Long Island talk with Bill Bleyer from 1 to 2:30.

events.title: Patriots Rock Living History
events.desc: Blacksmithing, talks about the 1777 Battle of Setauket, live music, a trading post, and McNulty's ice cream truck.

events.title: Brewster House Spy Tours
events.desc: Tour the oldest house in Brookhaven (c. 1665), once a tavern that served British troops while a Culper spy's cousin lived down the road. Suffolk 250 passport stamp stop.

events.title: Big Bill the Tory
events.desc: Hear the Loyalist side of the story from William Jayne III, who has some thoughts about Washington's pesky band of spies.

events.title: Scarecrow Competition Opens
events.desc: The 36th annual scarecrows take over Stony Brook Village. Grab a ballot in any shop and vote for your favorite through Oct. 25.

events.title: Stony Brook Symphony Orchestra
events.desc: Season opener: Anna Clyne, Stravinsky's Violin Concerto with Hyun Ji Lee, and Dvorak's 8th. Pre-concert talk at 6:30.
events.src: Stony Brook Music Dept. on Facebook

events.title: Port Jefferson Farmers Market
events.desc: Sunday market on the harbor. Back after last week's storm cancellation.

events.title: Free Sunday at the Long Island Museum
events.desc: Show your Culper Spy Day selfie for free admission. Carriage museum scavenger hunt for the kids.

events.title: Founding Families Exhibit
events.desc: A new exhibit at the historical society. Visited the SPIES! exhibit on Saturday? You get in free.

events.title: Stony Brook Grist Mill Tours
events.desc: One of the last Sundays of the season to see the working mill and its country store.

events.title: Marian Mastrorilli Live
events.desc: "Folk that rocks" from the Huntington singer-songwriter, with Glenn Govier, at the Long Island Music and Entertainment Hall of Fame.

events.title: An Evening with David Sedaris
events.desc: The humorist brings new stories and his famous Q&A to the Staller Main Stage.

allweekend.title: Cabaret
allweekend.desc: Theatre Three's mainstage run of the Kander and Ebb classic.

allweekend.title: Elephant & Piggie's We Are in a Play!
allweekend.desc: Mo Willems' best friends in a musical made for first-time theatergoers.

allweekend.title: Privateers at Drowned Meadow Cottage
allweekend.desc: Pirates with permission, storytelling for kids, and flax spinning. Free with a Spy Day selfie.

specials.title: Culper Spy Day Lunch & Brunch
specials.desc: Suffolk's oldest continuously running tavern (the old McDowell Saloon, ca. 1904) opens at 11 for Spy Day, with brunch from 11 to 2, craft beer and a view of the Brewster family home. Stop in before or after the festivities.

specials.title: Happy Hour Is Back
specials.desc: A special happy hour menu at the award-winning wine bar, running Tuesday through Friday.

specials.title: Spy Day Lunch Specials
specials.desc: The restaurant named for the ring itself. Reservations recommended.

specials.title: This Week's Specials
specials.desc: BBQ chicken mac and cheese, a chipotle steak quesadilla, Hector's lobster sandwich and creamy Italian sausage soup.

specials.title: Tequila & Mariachi Dinner
specials.desc: Five courses, five pours of 100% agave spirits and live mariachi. Spots are limited, so reserve now.

next.title: Port Jefferson Hill Climb
next.desc: Rescheduled from the storm. Antique cars retrace the 1910 climb up East Broadway.

next.title: Witches & Warlocks Weekend
next.desc: Spell jars, haunted harbor cruises and mischief all over Port Jeff.

next.title: Art of the Guitar Festival
next.desc: The John Monteleone festival returns to The Jazz Loft in Stony Brook.

next.title: Ixchel Tequila Dinner
next.desc: Five courses, five agave pours and mariachi at Ixchel in East Setauket. Spots are limited.
